description: This file is a Perl script for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device. It includes functionality for device discovery via UDP broadcast, FTP-based firmware upload, and device rebooting.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP providing additional commands specific to the ADAM2 device, such as getenv and reboot.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable from the FTP server using the GETENV command.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to retrieve an environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Issues the REBOOT command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.
